system.description: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.
system.notes:
Normal | Social

An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.
Motives & Tactics: Entice, maneuver, secure patrons

Difficulty: 13 | Thresholds: 7/13 | HP: 3 | Stress: 4

ATK: -3 | Weapon: Melee | 1d4+3 physical

Experience: Manipulation +3, Socialite +3

Features

Searing Glance - Reaction: When a PC within Close makes a Charm Roll, you can mark a Stress to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. If the target fails, they must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target’s success, they must mark a Stress.

Mockery - Action: Mark a Stress to say something mocking and force a target to make a Charm Reaction Roll (14). On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is Vulnerable until the scene ends.
